name: Alexandre Jollien
reason: Too thin for a page: his own site (www.alexandre-jollien.ch, French, read 10 Nov 2026 with its 10-second Crawl-delay) presents him as a writer and philosopher with no courses, sessions or retreats (only dated talks), no ISBNs for his books, no published base, and its only photos of him are 220x300 and 244x300 px, below the 300 px minimum; the YouTube avatar could not be taken because channel pages are off limits. Seven short French 'Pharmacopee' videos from his own channel passed oEmbed (y-8qcZzMR_Q, LcdJ3YIXcrc, mkS21o97ABU, dPAJRlFh9Os, A28WhYKGDZA, Db1dPOY_rQw, yXvaVBnlM5c) and email info@alexandre-jollien.ch is published on /parcours/, should the owner want him with a photo supplied.
